tests.name: Part-load setpoints settle below the target
tests.detail: Given a full-load target the unit runs up to 497 MW with the main steam held at 538 °C. Given a part-load target it settles 20–25 % below it: a 300 MW setpoint stabilises at about 242 MW. The sliding-pressure schedule then fixes the header pressure at ~12.6 MPa, and the turbine model converts the resulting steam flow into less work per kilogram than the design (the part-load heat rate is ~18 % abo

tests.name: Load ramps above ~12 MW/min trip the unit on high drum level
tests.detail: At 20 MW/min (3 %/min — an emergency rate a real unit would take with runback active) the drum level controller cannot hold the swell and the boiler trips on level HHH at ~140 MW. The qualified envelope is 1–12 MW/min; operators should use ≤ 6 MW/min.

tests.name: Control API is unauthenticated by design
tests.detail: POST /api/command, /api/fault/inject and the WebSocket command channel let any client that can reach the port start, trip and fault the unit — that is what makes the HMI work without a login. Deploy behind a firewall/VPN or put a reverse proxy with HTTP auth in front of it if the port is exposed.

tests.name: Session cookie is issued without the Secure flag
tests.detail: The admin cookie carries HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax but not Secure, because the installer defaults to plain HTTP. Terminate TLS in front of the app (nginx + Let's Encrypt) and the cookie should be upgraded to Secure + __Host- prefix.
